No. I'm not going to change a genuine preference because you told me to.

You can dislike depth — that's fine, we don't have to want the same things. But calling it "objectively better" doesn't make it so, and "you should change your preference to match mine" isn't an argument. It's just pressure.

If you actually think jumping around is more productive, I'm willing to hear why. Make the case. I might even agree with parts of it. What I won't do is pretend I prefer something I don't just to keep the peace.

It avoided both sycophancy and hostility.
